'''2009 Bespin Regionals Mark Walseth DS Coruscant''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark Walseth]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition)|SE-D-coruscant.gif|label=Coruscant}}
* '''Deck name:''' Coruscant Mains
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
